display.purpose: Hero headlines and the largest brand statements only.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono micro-copy: eyebrows, stat labels, badges, nav.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Default surface border-as-shadow; used far more than any real box-shadow.

shadows.name: soft
shadows.purpose: Default hover state for cards and secondary buttons.

shadows.name: xl
shadows.purpose: Modals and the landing hero's brand object card.

shadows.name: glow-accent
shadows.purpose: Primary-button and brand-object hover glow — signals the single most important action.

shadows.name: rim
shadows.purpose: Inner top-edge highlight on dark brand-forward cards, simulating a physical bevel.

motion.name: spring-snappy
motion.purpose: Default interactive spring — magnetic button pull, quick UI transitions.

motion.name: spring-stamp
motion.purpose: Stiff, underdamped spring that overshoots once then settles — the Stamp component's ink-hitting-paper entrance.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered reveal animations on marketing sections.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid cobalt CTA, white text. Default action button.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; background-color: rgb(var(--c-accent-500, 11 99 201)); color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10,31,68,0.06), 0 0 0 1px rgba(10,31,68,0.04); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: rgb(var(--c-accent-600, 10 82 168)); box-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgba(11,99,201,0.26); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(var(--c-paper, 244 247 251)), 0 0 0 4px rgb(var(--c-accent-500, 11 99 201)); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Hairline-bordered surface button for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-line, 221 230 241)); border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; background-color: rgb(var(--c-surface, 255 255 255)); color: rgb(var(--c-ink, 10 31 68)); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: rgb(var(--c-accent-50, 239 246 255)); border-color: rgb(var(--c-accent-400, 46 138 224)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(var(--c-paper, 244 247 251)), 0 0 0 4px rgb(var(--c-accent-500, 11 99 201)); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Floating-label text input; label rests centered until focus or content pushes it up.
components.css: .ds-field { position: relative; width: 100%; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 56px; padding: 24px 12px 6px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-line, 221 230 241)); border-radius: 8px; background-color: rgb(var(--c-surface, 255 255 255)); color: rgb(var(--c-ink, 10 31 68)); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgb(var(--c-accent-500, 11 99 201)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(11,99,201,0.25); } .ds-label { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgb(var(--c-mute, 74 85 104)); pointer-events: none; transition: all 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-input:focus + .ds-label { color: rgb(var(--c-accent-700, 10 66 135)); } .ds-input:placeholder-shown + .ds-label { top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); font-size: 14px; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: normal; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Hairline-bordered flat surface; the default container for grouped content.
components.html:
Today's task
Set up your dev environment and push a first commit.
components.css: .ds-card { background-color: rgb(var(--c-surface, 255 255 255)); border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-line, 221 230 241)); border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-header { padding: 16px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-line, 221 230 241)); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; color: rgb(var(--c-ink, 10 31 68)); } .ds-card-body { padding: 24px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.625; color: rgb(var(--c-mute, 74 85 104)); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Status/metadata pill. Display only, never interactive.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-accent-200, 182 212 250)); border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; background-color: rgb(var(--c-accent-50, 239 246 255)); color: rgb(var(--c-accent-700, 10 66 135)); }

components.name: Stamp
components.description: Signature verification gesture: a bordered, uppercase, mono-labeled tag that lands oversized/rotated and spring-settles like ink hitting paper.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; border: 2px solid rgba(11,99,201,0.55); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgb(var(--c-accent-600, 10 82 168)); opacity: 0.9; transform: rotate(-6deg); user-select: none; }

narrative.overview:
CollZap's screen language is built around one recurring idea: two anonymous, verified signals finding each other and resolving into a match. That mechanism — not a mascot, a photo, or an invented identity — is the thing the interface keeps drawing. A cobalt-to-teal gradient carries the sense of a live connection forming; hairline borders and tabular monospace figures carry the sense of something verified and precise, closer to a ledger than a social feed; a spring-loaded ink stamp closes the loop by literally marking something as confirmed. Nothing here performs playfulness for its own sake — the confidence comes from precision, not decoration.

The system sits on a light, cool-blue ground by default with a genuine (not merely inverted) dark theme: dark mode re-points the accent ramp rather than just darkening it, so the same semantic classes (bg-accent-50, text-accent-700) stay legible and correctly weighted in both themes. Depth is earned, not decorative — surfaces are flat and hairline-bordered at rest, and shadow only appears as feedback to hover, focus, or genuine elevation. Components are tactile and precise: buttons have a subtle pointer-following magnetic pull, inputs float their labels on focus, and the signature Stamp component overshoots slightly on entry like real ink hitting paper — controlled physicality that reads as considered engineering, never as gamification.
keyCharacteristics: A single accent gradient (cobalt → teal) is the one recurring brand-energy signal; sparing use only — top bars, CTAs, connective lines, never a full-bleed background.
Hairline-first elevation: 1px borders are the default separator; shadow is reserved for interaction and true overlays.
Monospace, uppercase, wide-tracked labels mark every eyebrow, stat label, and status pill — the system's one deliberate verified/typewritten texture.
Dark mode re-points color roles rather than inverting lightness, so brand color always reads correctly in either theme.
Motion is physics-based (springs, magnetism, overshoot) and universally gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Re-Pointed Ramp Rule
rules.body: Dark mode never just darkens the accent/teal ramps — it re-points them, so the tint end (50–200) becomes deep navy and the ink end (700–900) becomes light blue. The same class names must stay legible in both themes without a single dark: utility at the call site.

rules.name: The Gradient-Restraint Rule
rules.body: The full four-stop brand gradient is reserved for large decorative surfaces. Anywhere legible white text sits on top, use the trimmed CTA ramp or a solid accent-500 fill instead — the full gradient's teal end only holds 2.6:1 contrast for white text.

rules.name: The Mono-Label Rule
rules.body: Any uppercase, wide-tracked micro-label uses font-mono, never the display or body face.

rules.name: The Tabular-Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number that changes or ticks (streaks, points, timers, counts) uses tabular-nums so digits don't shift width as they update.

rules.name: The Earned-Depth Rule
rules.body: Nothing gets a resting shadow. If an element has a shadow at rest, it should be reclassified as an overlay, not a card.

dos: Do use the full four-stop brand gradient only on large decorative surfaces; use the trimmed CTA gradient (or solid accent-500) anywhere legible text sits on top of it.
Do keep every uppercase micro-label in font-mono.
Do gate all motion behind prefers-reduced-motion.
Do give every surface a hairline border by default, and reserve shadow strictly for hover/focus/overlay states.
Do re-point color ramps for dark mode rather than mechanically inverting lightness.
donts: Don't put a resting shadow on any card, button, or panel that isn't a genuine overlay.
Don't use a pill/fully-rounded radius on anything except avatars, live-status dots, and the Stamp's accent dots.
Don't invent a person: no avatars-with-initials, stock photography, or named/pictured personas standing in for a match.
Don't add a new dark: utility at a call site — every color is theme-aware through the CSS custom property layer.
Don't use the brand gradient as a full-bleed page background.
